key_point: Devil May Cry is a rejected version of Resident Evil 4
title: Devil May Cry began as Resident Evil 4.
caption: Devil May Cry began as Resident Evil 4. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #devilmaycry #residentevil #capcom

instagram.caption:
Devil May Cry began as Resident Evil 4.

Director Hideki Kamiya made his version so fast and stylish that Capcom decided it wasn't a horror game anymore.

Instead of scrapping the work, they gave it a new name and a new hero, Dante. Its famous air combos came from a bug in Onimusha, where enemies could be kept in the air with hits.

Devil May Cry or Resident Evil?
